documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for BOARD MEETING TO BE HELD ON 04.11.2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited reported a significant revenue increase to Rs. 849,933 lakhs in FY 2025-26, supported by organic growth and contributions from newly operated Chennai retail outlets. EBITDA reached Rs. 57,674 lakhs and PAT improved to Rs. 35,165 lakhs.

guidance.claim: Management plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
guidance.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the overall size of the market in volume terms is shrinking modestly.
demand_outlook.quote: d. Continued unhealthy competition prevailing in the market as the over all size of the market in volume terms shrinking modestly.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer base is slated to increase to 40 lakhs by 31/03/26.
demand_outlook.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

capex_expansion.claim: Capital work-in-progress as of March 31, 2024 stood at Rs. 236 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: The capital work in progress amount outstanding as on 31st March 2024 is `236 lakhs (previous year `160 lakhs).

margins_costs.claim: On a retail revenue growth of 28%, expenses managed to improve by only 10%.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization done. On a retail revenue growth of 28% the cost managed to improve only by 10%

orders_capacity.claim: Maximum operational retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft in February 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Maximum operational Retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft (February 2025)

orders_capacity.claim: Retail space increased by 17.46% to reach 104,000 sq ft.
orders_capacity.quote: Retail Space (increases by 17.46%) 104000 sq ft 88000 sq ft 18%

risks_headwinds.claim: Continued unhealthy competition prevails among both unorganized and organized players.
risks_headwinds.quote: Continued unhealthy competition prevailing both in unorganised and organised players.

risks_headwinds.claim: An extraordinary shift is taking place among the younger population toward other discretionary spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Extra ordinary shift is taking place among younger population for other discretionary spending.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
management_commitments.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

management_commitments.claim: Customer base is slated to increase to 40 lakhs by 31/03/26.
management_commitments.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open the flagship Chennai outlet by January 2025.
management_commitments.quote: To open flagship Chennai outlet by Jan 2025.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to further improve high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales.
management_commitments.quote: Further improve the high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to improve stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to improve gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
